The '''Inter-Academy League''' was a collection of [[Grav-ball/Legends|grav-ball]] teams within the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] network. [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] played for the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida's]] team.
